title_sq: Tek Rruga 5 Maji, Shitet Apartament 1+1 I Investuar!!!

title_en: On 5 Maji Street, 1+1 Invested Apartment For Sale!!!
description_en: On 5 Maji Street, Newly Invested 1+1 Apartment For Sale!!! The apartment is located on the 6th floor of a new building with an elevator. It has a total area of ​​49 m2 and a net area of ​​43 m2. The apartment is organized by the entrance corridor, the living room with the kitchen corner, a bedroom, a bathroom and the balcony. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting with the plumbing system, flush toilet, electrical system, doors, parquet, flooring, etc. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area.
